info.accent_color: Used for selected states and small emphasis. Buttons stay outlined in white by default.
info.assurances: Shown under the add-to-cart button. Leave a field empty to hide that line. Only state promises you can keep.
info.accordion_content: Leave empty to hide that accordion. Do not invent policies you have not published in Shopify.
info.policy_links: Uses Shopify Settings → Policies when URLs are empty. Assign page URLs here to override. Hidden until at least one destination exists.
info.media_treatment: Blend dissolves the photo into the field so it never reads as a card. Scrim suits brighter interiors.
info.whatsapp_number: Include the country code and no spaces, for example 917988355887. Leave empty to hide the enquiry block.
info.whatsapp_message: Prefilled message. The product name is added to the end automatically.
info.contact_whatsapp_message: Prefilled WhatsApp message when this topic is selected.
info.email_subject: Prefilled subject when this topic opens email.
info.phone_display: Shown on the WhatsApp button. Leave empty to use the WhatsApp number.
info.accent_contrast_color: Text colour placed on top of the accent. Check it stays legible if you change the accent.
info.customer_tag: Applied to customers who sign up here, so you can segment drop notifications.
info.dark_color: Used for inverted panels. Keep it near black to match the rest of the storefront.
info.description_fallback_collection: Leave empty to use the collection description.
info.empty_url_all_products: Leave empty to use the Shopify all-products collection.
info.footer_menu: Optional. If empty, fallback links below are used.
info.assigned_image_only: Shown only when an image is selected. An empty image setting does not render a placeholder.
info.image_placeholder: Assign in the theme editor. A placeholder frame is shown until an image is selected.
info.stamp_image: Optional. Replaces the generated stamp when selected.
info.build_commerce_collection: Select the current drop collection. Its Shopify URL is used for the button when set.
info.build_commerce_link: Used when no collection is selected. Falls back to the Drop 001 collection if that collection exists.
info.cart_continue_link: Continue shopping destination. Falls back to the Drop 001 collection if that collection exists.
info.factory_video: Optional. Upload under Content → Files, then select it here. Plays muted and looping when in view. Hidden until a video is selected. Honors reduced-motion preferences.
info.step_video: Optional clip for this stage. Shown instead of the step image when both are set. Same muted in-view playback as the main video.
info.faq_categories: Optional. Leave empty to show every published FAQ category from Custom data. Picking categories here controls order.
info.faq_blocks: Used only when no FAQ metaobjects are published. Group questions by typing the same category title.
info.header_menu: Optional. If empty, fallback links below are used.
info.hero_image: Optional desktop image. Displays full-bleed behind the hero copy from left to right. Assign in the theme editor. Leave empty for a copy-only hero.
info.hero_image_mobile: Optional. Used below 750px instead of the desktop image. Leave empty to reuse the desktop image.
info.hero_placeholder_label: Shown only while no hero image is selected. Leave empty to hide.
info.overlay_image: Optional graphic layered on the section. Hidden until an image is selected.
info.badge_image: Optional stamp or badge over the hero image. Hidden until selected.
info.coming_soon: When enabled, the card does not link through and shows the status text instead.
info.heading_fallback: Leave empty to use the page title.
info.heading_fallback_collection: Leave empty to use the collection title.
info.image_fallback_collection: Leave empty to use the collection image.
info.related_collection: Leave empty to use the first collection this product belongs to.
info.product_drop_fallback: Used only when the product is not in a drop collection.
info.pdp_image: Assign in the theme editor. Leave empty to keep a placeholder frame until photography is ready. Connect a product metafield if this image should change per product.
info.reduce_motion: Also respects the visitor's system reduced-motion preference.
